This application coming on for admission this day, the c  following:
 ORDER
The applicant has filed this FIRST bail application under Section 439 of Cr.P.C. for grant of bail.

Applicant is a man of 23 years and has been arrested on 07.01.2023 by Police Station - Ranjhi,
District Jabalpur for the offences punishable under Sections 376, 376 (2), 294 and 506 of the IPC.
It is submitted by the learned counsel for the applicant that the applicant is suffering confinement since 07.01.2023 and no custodial interrogation is required.
It is further submitted that story indicates an improbable event.

It is highly improbable that at such weer of 4.00 a.m., applicant knocked the door and prosecutrix opened the door and he entered into the house and committed rape, specially when the family members including the husband were sleeping in the house.
Medical report belies the allegation.
Confinement amounts to pre- trial detention specially when the applicant does not bear any criminal record.
The applicant undertakes to cooperate in trial and would not be a source of embarrassment and harassment to the prosecutrix in any manner.

Under Vishal Choudhary vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh on 17 February, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/80048584/
1 these grounds, counsel prayed for bail.

entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: Learned Government Advocate for the State opposed the prayer and prayed for its dismissal.
Heard learned counsel for the parties at length and perused the case diary.
Considering the above submissions advanced by the learned counsel for the parties but without commenting on the merits of the case, the application is allowed.

It is hereby directed that the applicant shall be released on bail on his furnishing personal bond of Rs.50,000/- (Rupees Fifty Thousand Only) with one solvent surety in the like amount to the satisfaction of trial Court.
A copy of this order be sent to the trial Court concerned for compliance and information.
Certified copy as per rules.
